name: BentoTileArt
label: Bento tile art
description: The texture half of a bento tile's shader pair: six fine patterns in one vocabulary, fading in from a corner.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Which pattern to draw. Unset, it follows its tile's shader pair (pinned by `highlight`, or by position); outside a tile it draws `dots`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the layer.
